title.en: The central bank: Reserve Bank of India

hook.en: You cannot open a savings account at the Reserve Bank of India. Yet every rupee note in your pocket carries the RBI Governor's signature. What does this bank do?
hook.kn: ನೀವು ಭಾರತೀಯ ರಿಸರ್ವ್ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿತಾಯ ಖಾತೆ ತೆರೆಯಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ. ಆದರೂ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೇಬಿನ ಪ್ರತಿ ನೋಟಿನ ಮೇಲೆ RBI ಗವರ್ನರ್ ಸಹಿ ಇದೆ. ಈ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಏನು ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ?

objectives.en: Explain the meaning of a central bank
State the functions of the RBI

narration.en: You cannot open a savings account at the Reserve Bank of India. Yet every rupee note in your pocket carries the RBI Governor's signature. What does this bank do?
narration.kn: ನೀವು ಭಾರತೀಯ ರಿಸರ್ವ್ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿತಾಯ ಖಾತೆ ತೆರೆಯಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ. ಆದರೂ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೇಬಿನ ಪ್ರತಿ ನೋಟಿನ ಮೇಲೆ RBI ಗವರ್ನರ್ ಸಹಿ ಇದೆ. ಈ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಏನು ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ?

body.en: The Reserve Bank of India, set up in 1935, is India's central bank. It is the bank of issue: it alone issues currency notes, except one-rupee notes. It is banker to the government, managing its accounts and borrowing. It is the banker's bank: commercial banks keep reserves with it, and it is the lender of last resort in a crisis. It is the custodian of foreign exchange reserves and the controller of money supply and credit.
body.kn: 1935ರಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆಯಾದ ಭಾರತೀಯ ರಿಸರ್ವ್ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಭಾರತದ ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್. ಇದು ನೋಟು ಮುದ್ರಣದ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್, ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕರ್, ಬ್ಯಾಂಕುಗಳ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂತಿಮ ಸಾಲದಾತ, ವಿದೇಶಿ ವಿನಿಮಯ ಮೀಸಲಿನ ಪಾಲಕ, ಹಾಗೂ ಹಣ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಲದ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಕ.

points.en: Banker's bank and lender of last resort
Controller of money supply and credit

title.en: On the board: The many hats of the RBI

say.en: The Reserve Bank of India, set up in 1935, is India's central bank.
It issues currency notes, except the one-rupee note, and is banker to the government.
It is the bankers' bank and lender of last resort, and the custodian of foreign exchange.
Above all it controls money and credit: enough for growth, not so much that prices soar.

prompt.en: Match each function of the Reserve Bank of India with what it means.
prompt.kn: RBI ಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕಾರ್ಯವನ್ನು ಅದರ ಅರ್ಥದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ.

right.en: Alone issues currency notes, except one-rupee notes
Manages the government's accounts and borrowing
Commercial banks keep their reserves with it
Lends to banks in a crisis when no one else will
Holds and manages the country's foreign exchange reserves
Regulates money supply and credit to keep prices stable

explanation.en: The RBI, set up in 1935, does not compete with commercial banks; it supervises and guides them and manages money and credit for the whole economy.

body.en: Too much money chasing too few goods causes inflation; too little money and credit slows production and employment. The RBI therefore regulates the amount of money and credit to keep prices stable while supporting growth. It does not compete with commercial banks for deposits; it supervises and guides them.
body.kn: ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಹಣ ಹಣದುಬ್ಬರಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣ; ಕಡಿಮೆ ಹಣ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಯೋಗವನ್ನು ನಿಧಾನಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ RBI ಬೆಲೆ ಸ್ಥಿರತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆಗಾಗಿ ಹಣ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಲವನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದು ವಾಣಿಜ್ಯ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕುಗಳ ಮೇಲ್ವಿಚಾರಣೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: Match each situation to an RBI function: (a) a bank faces a sudden rush of withdrawals and borrows from the RBI; (b) the RBI manages the Centre's loans from the market; (c) new ₹500 notes are printed; (d) the RBI holds US dollars earned from exports.

answer.en: (a) lender of last resort, (b) banker to government, (c) bank of issue, (d) custodian of forex.
